description:
BROE auctioneers are delighted to present 22 Carrow Road to the market. This stunning two-bedroom property is situated in one of the most desirable areas of Dublin 12. The home has been maintained to an impeccable standard and offers a fantastic opportunity to become part of the community. The property features modern upgrades, including new kitchen and doors, as well as a resin-bonded driveway at the front. The interior living space is bright and airy throughout. Upon entering the ground floor, you are welcomed by a hallway that leads to an open-plan kitchen and dining room, which was fully renovated in 2022. This area is flooded with natural light and overlooks a private, low-maintenance, south-facing rear garden. At the front of the property, there is a cosy lounge area perfect for relaxation. The first floor comprises two bedrooms and a main bathroom. At the rear of the property is a south-facing garden that is not overlooked and features a large shed that is wired for electricity. This shed provides ample storage and versatility, making it suitable for various uses. The location of Carrow Road is exceptional. The property is conveniently situated near a variety of excellent amenities, including Our Lady's Children’s Hospital, shopping options, and numerous recreational, sporting, and educational facilities. Transportation is easily accessible, with the Blackhorse LUAS providing quick access to the city center, the M50 motorway and beyond. Given its attractive features and prime location, this property is likely to generate significant interest, so early viewing is strongly recommended.

Contact Shauna O' Brien to register your interest today.
